name: paperclip
description: Paperclip in Claude Code: pin an issue to the session, see the board in a pane, and let Claude read and comment on issues.

company.title: Company
company.description: Issue prefix (AIM), name or id. Leave blank to pick one in the pane.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Only for authenticated deployments. Sent as a Bearer token. Local trusted mode needs none.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the board refreshes. 0 turns it off.
